pr_body:
The apiserver may be configured to generate the Service
kubernetes.default and its endpoints addresses.

This service is single-stack, hence, the endpoints and the ClusterIP
must have the same IP family.

/kind bug
Fixes #106709

```release-note
apiserver, if configured to reconcile the kubernetes.default service endpoints, checks if the configured Service IP range matches the apiserver public address IP family, and fails to start if not.
```
